The owner, 2026-10-29: "give me proposals for 5 more HTML artifacts that properly display one portion of the built or planned subject artitechture ... It should list all open questions, and it should give a response form where I can respond". This page is the first of the five, and the hub of the other four: every question every open issue is still asking, in one place, with a box beside each to answer it.

Where the questions settle

Every capability the project has sits in one of seven rings, from the ground the game's files describe out to the operations that build and run it (the capability architecture). A question settles into the ring of the issue that asks it. An issue the architecture has not placed yet is listed as "not yet placed", and placing it is part of answering.

One answer unlocks many

Issues wait on each other: an issue's "Blocked by", "Depends on" and "Dependencies" lines name what it waits for, a "Blocks" line names what waits on it, and a sub-issue waits on its parent's design. Following those lines all the way down gives each issue a count: how many open issues are held up, directly or through others, until it moves. The questions below are sorted by that count, so the first ones you answer are the ones that free the most work.

How an answer travels

  1. You type into the box beside a question and press send.
  2. The answer server on this computer (scripts/answer-server) appends it to this page's answers file, notes/answers/open-questions.md: the date, the issue, the question quoted, and your words as typed.
  3. This page reads that file back and shows your answer under its question, whenever you come back.
  4. The next agent that works on the issue copies your answer into it, word for word, and the question is marked answered there.

The box works only when the page is opened through the answer server (start it with scripts/answer-server, then open http://127.0.0.1:8642/answer-pages/open-questions.html). Opened as a plain file, the page still reads, and the boxes say so.

Answered, a ripple at a time

Answered questions stay listed, marked and folded, so a question that looks open is open. The count at the top of the list says how many are left.
